chatMessages.text: Riya, I did the exercise you gave us. The commute audit, for BOTH careers. Three of our four shortlist decisions optimized Neel's home office. Mine got a 'nice-ish' drive.

That's what the data says — and it happened silently, which is how it always happens. Nobody chose it; the house kept choosing it. So: Raintree Boulevard. Twenty minutes closer to Mahima's studio, the park for Neel's dawn walks, and a residents' book club with four returnee-founder women.

tabs.insightTitle: What I noticed while we were searching
tabs.insightDescription: “These two came home with inverted requirements and the discipline to match: fiber panels photographed from the riser, generator logs requested in writing, the school run rehearsed at 7:40 am. But the real finding wasn't in the infrastructure — it was the career audit. Three of four shortlist decisions had silently optimized Neel's night-shift office over Mahima's studio commute. Nobody chose it; the house kept choosing it, the way it always does in a two-timezone marriage. The rebalance to Raintree — twenty minutes closer to her studio — was the single most important decision of the whole search. Load-bearing careers get load-bearing addresses. Both of them.”
